    right_elements = [x for x in nodes[1:] if x > nodes[0]]
    
    # Recursively build subtrees
    root.left = build_tree_from_preorder(left_elements)
    root.right = build_tree_from_preorder(right_elements)

def find_path(root, target_condition, current_path=None, all_paths=None):
    if current_path is None:
        current_path = []
    if all_paths is None:
        all_paths = []
    
    # Add current node to path
    current_path.append(root.data)
    
    # Check if current path satisfies the condition
    if target_condition(current_path):
        all_paths.append(current_path.copy())
    
    # Explore left subtree
    if root.left:
        find_path(root.left, target_condition, current_path, all_paths)
    
    # Explore right subtree
    if root.right:
        find_path(root.right, target_condition, current_path, all_paths)
    
    # Backtrack
    current_path.pop()
    
    return all_paths
